desc:
【Crazy Odyssey】 : A New Journey 

A Korean-style MMORPG where you can cultivate your own hero across four seasons on the continent.
Choose a profession, hunt monsters, and hone your skills and weapons to challenge the highest combat power.

We are currently preparing for several updates.

▪ Occupations and Skills - Different weapons and impressive skills for each occupation. Choose based on your preferences and grow from there. 
▪ Spacious hunting grounds - zones divided by seasons, with thousands of monsters and elite variants. 
▪ World Boss - A competition of contribution against the world dragon that shakes the continent. 
▪ Raid Dungeon - Fight against various patterns 
▪ 8-person party - Hunting together results in XP sharing and synergy boost from职业组合. 
▪ Guild & Territory Battles - Establish a guild, display your flag to challenge territories, and gather combat power to rise in rankings.
